source: 3. What are the major stages of a production ZXNAME0000XZ pipeline, and why should parsing, retrieval, context assembly, and generation be evaluated separately? [Intermediate - System Design] A production pipeline commonly has at least these stages: source ingestion and parsing; document segmentation; indexing; query interpretation; candidate retrieval; optional fusion or reranking; authorization filtering; context selection and ordering; generation; attribution; and logging/evaluation. Each stage creates different failures. A table may be parsed incorrectly even if retrieval is perfect. The right passage may be absent from the candidate set. A reranker may discard it. The passage may be present in the prompt but the generator may ignore it. An answer may be correct yet cite the wrong source. End-to-end accuracy alone hides these distinctions. The UDA benchmark, for example, explicitly studies parsing, retrieval, generation, and end-to-end document analysis as separate design choices. The engineering lesson is to retain enough intermediate artifacts - parsed units, retrieved IDs and scores, reranked context, final prompt, citations - to test the pipeline layer by layer. [3]
zh: 3. 生产 ZXNAME0000XZ 管道的主要阶段是什么？为什么要单独评估解析、检索、上下文组装和生成？ [中级-系统设计] 生产管道通常至少有以下阶段：源摄取和解析；文档分割；索引；查询解释；候选检索；可选的融合或重新排名；授权过滤；上下文选择和排序；一代;归因;和记录/评估。每个阶段都会造成不同的失败。即使检索完美，表也可能被错误地解析。候选集中可能不存在正确的段落。重新排名者可能会丢弃它。该段落可能出现在提示中，但生成器可能会忽略它。答案可能是正确的，但引用了错误的来源。仅端到端的准确性就隐藏了这些区别。例如，UDA 基准明确将解析、检索、生成和端到端文档分析作为单独的设计选择进行研究。工程课程是保留足够的中间工件 - 解析的单元、检索的 ID 和分数、重新排序的上下文、最终提示、引用 - 来逐层测试管道。 [3]
